description.zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

- zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
- ja：日文。

> 该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效。
description.en:
The language in which you want to return the descriptions of the access control policies. Valid values:

- zh-CN (default value): Chinese
- en: English
- ja: Japanese

>  This parameter is valid only for system access control policies.

description.zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1。
description.en:
The number of the page to return. 

Page start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页时每页显示的数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. 

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

- System：系统管控策略。
- Custom：自定义管控策略。
description.en:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

- System: system access control policy
- Custom: custom access control policy

descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the system access control policies within a resource directory. The response shows that the resource directory has only one system access control policy. The policy is named `FullAliyunAccess`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-control-policies --policy-type System --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
